edits.edit_diff:
--- /linux/mm/rmap.c
+++ /linux/mm/rmap.c
@@ -2450,0 +2451,10 @@
+		/*
+		 * If we have a writable (or exclusive) pte for an anon folio,
+		 * it must be exclusive. However, if somehow we missed clearing
+		 * the pte write bit or dropping exclusivity on the folio,
+		 * we can't create a writable migration entry as that would
+		 * mean breaking COW. Start over by removing write access.
+		 */
+		if (unlikely(writable && folio_test_anon(folio) && !anon_exclusive))
+			writable = false;
+
